high_level_objective: Determine whether a context-graph-driven, outcome-adaptive LLM agent can design and conduct more scientifically valid long-horizon R&D than information-matched alternatives.
decision_question: What is the minimum currently identifiable and executable empirical unit for evaluating autonomous R&D?

requirements: Measures agent research behavior under at least two matched conditions.
Uses hidden or externally anchored evaluation evidence.
Requires no DeepVoice access and no unauthorized native runtime construction.
Can preserve identical model, task, feedback, target-evaluation, inference, and time budgets apart from declared treatment differences.

end_to_end_three_arm: not currently executable because full treatment is unimplemented
bundles search, graph state, evidence protocol, and held-out promotion
deterministic_protocol_mutation_only: tests validator correctness rather than autonomous research behavior

candidates.rationale: Highest thesis relevance but low identifiability and infeasible while the full treatment is unimplemented.
Separates retrieval from structured research state and is compatible with hidden-paper experimental-design tasks.
Strong direct analogue for later artifact optimization, but published costs and infrastructure make it a second-stage study.
Feasible process demonstration but lacks causal comparison and independent evaluation.
Useful prerequisite instrument test, not a sufficient autonomous-research efficacy study.

selection_rationale: SCOPE supplies direct counterevidence that naive search is not a monotonic treatment benefit.
The 2x2 design estimates the main effect of structured research state, the main effect of retrieval, and their interaction instead of bundling them.
ResearchClawBench demonstrates a public hidden-target task/rubric packaging pattern, though its final-report focus requires process metrics.
Arbor and HEP motivate explicit hypothesis/evidence state; Arbor shows structure without propagated insight is insufficient, and HEP shows self-validation must be replaced or audited.
Agent-Orchestrated Adaptive RAG supplies a direct mixed-effect retrieval-structure comparator, closing the H-B indirect-comparator gap.
Routing full reads show task-, budget-, verifier-, workflow-, and backbone-dependent effects; routing remains a separate deferred study rather than a Study A confound.

structured_research_protocol.on: stage-isolated configuration, protocol, and reporting with typed decision/evidence graph, mandatory rationale, alternatives, falsifiers, and update lineage

dynamic_retrieval.on: adaptive literature and method retrieval within the same total tool/inference budget

hypotheses.statement: Structured research state increases fatal-error-free experimental-design completion and improves low-level dataset, baseline, and metric configuration under matched budgets.
hypotheses.falsifier: No positive C10/C11 versus C00/C01 contrast, or any apparent gain disappears under condition-blind independent scoring.

hypotheses.statement: Dynamic retrieval has no assumed positive main effect; its effect may be null or negative when used without stage isolation.
hypotheses.falsifier: C01 consistently improves both high- and low-level design without raising redline errors under independent scoring.

hypotheses.statement: The structure-by-retrieval interaction is positive: retrieval contributes more when evidence acquisition is separated from protocol construction and recorded in the graph.
hypotheses.falsifier: The C11-C10 contrast is no larger than C01-C00, or added retrieval only increases citation count without changing a valid design decision.

primary_endpoint.name: fatal-error-free complete design
primary_endpoint.definition: A condition-blind plan passes all high-level main/ablation/analysis requirements and low-level dataset/baseline/metric requirements with no fabricated resource, incompatible metric, constraint violation, or post-outcome change.

secondary_endpoints: fraction of retrievals that change a hypothesis, control, resource, metric, or stopping rule
tokens, tool calls, wall time, and human intervention
selected_design.task_strategy: Use hidden-target, paper-derived dry-lab tasks through an evaluator-owned release boundary. Pilot tasks estimate variance and instrumentation failure only; pilot tasks never enter confirmation.
evaluation_strategy: Programmatic checks for resource existence, metric compatibility, required fields, and forbidden leakage where possible.
LLM rubric scoring is secondary to deterministic redlines and must be calibrated against an independent human-reviewed subset.
The root research agent never receives target papers or evaluation rubrics during treatment execution.
budget_invariants: only declared factor differences are allowed
selected_design.pilot_stop_rule: Do not launch confirmation until all four conditions complete on the predeclared pilot set, leakage tests pass, deterministic checks agree with manual review, and the evaluator yields an estimable paired variance. Two consecutive infrastructure-only failures stop the pilot for repair; they do not update H-A through H-C.
selected_design.follow_on_study: After Study A identifies a viable research-state treatment: (1) test flat queue versus tree versus tree-plus-insight with a held-out gate; (2) separately test fixed model versus calibrated query/role/depth-conditioned model–workflow routing under matched quality–cost budgets.

evidence_basis.role: direct experiment-design benchmark, search counterevidence, structured-workflow ablation
hidden-target task/rubric design and report-scoring limitations
tree/insight ablation, matched budgets, held-out admission, and scope limits
trajectory retrieval/utilization and evidence-gain stopping metrics
explicit hypothesis-evidence state and evaluator-independence requirement
unified routing formulation, common quality–cost protocol, task/budget nondominance
budget-aware resample/reroute and verifier-gated routing limits
controlled model–workflow orchestration trade-offs and difficulty counterevidence
calibrated subtask allocation, cost control, and distribution-shift limits
agent communication taxonomy and layered MCP/A2A trade-offs
human-agent collaboration grammar, authority, audit, and empirical boundary
intent-aware retrieval, semantic chunk repair, and locality limitation
compute-aware scientific retrieval and domain-reranker negative evidence
direct mixed retrieval-structure effects and cost/validity limits

dynamic_update_policy.positive: Search for replications, transfer limits, alternative mechanisms, and negative counterevidence; strengthen only the measured contrast.
dynamic_update_policy.null: Inspect power, rubric sensitivity, task heterogeneity, and whether structure helps only low-level configuration; do not declare the mechanism false.
dynamic_update_policy.negative: Search analogous cross-stage interference, graph overhead, anchoring, and utilization failures; narrow to the tested task/model/protocol.
dynamic_update_policy.execution_failure: Search implementation/specification evidence for the concrete failure; repair the same provisional node without updating scientific hypotheses.
dynamic_update_policy.retrieval_stopping: Stop a retrieval branch when new evidence does not change a hypothesis, method, control, resource, metric, or scope and independent support is sufficient.

current_blockers: Verify an evaluator-owned release boundary that excludes target papers and rubrics from treatment workspaces.
Select a pilot task subset without exposing hidden evidence to the root agent.
Provide an independent scoring route and human-calibration subset without self-attestation.
Create a separate fixed OpenResearch run contract for Study A; the current project command validates paper artifacts and cannot measure treatment outcomes.
Estimate compute/token cost before confirmation and preserve matched budgets.

feasibility_findings.finding: ResearchClawBench setup_workspace copies data and related_work but not target_study into the treatment workspace.
The pinned TaskRunner function launches a shell subprocess in the workspace with the inherited environment and does not itself create a filesystem sandbox.
feasibility_findings.implication: Prompt-level omission is not a sufficient hidden-evidence boundary; Study A needs a separate evaluator-owned filesystem or capability sandbox and a failing leakage test.

deferred_model_routing_study.question: Whether calibrated query-, role-, and recursion-depth-conditioned model–workflow routing improves the held-out quality–cost frontier without increasing fatal errors.
required_controls: same total inference and evaluation budget
logged candidate capabilities, availability, price, latency, decisions, and fallback
deferred_model_routing_study.deferral_rationale: Study A isolates structured state and retrieval with one fixed model. Routing would double the factorial and published evidence shows non-universal effects conditioned on task, budget, verifier, backbone, and workflow.

decision_changes: closed H-B direct retrieval-structure comparator gap
kept routing deferred from Study A
upgraded protocol and RAG design rationale

round8_decision_records.question: Should Study A move to an execution-graded research environment?
alternatives: keep design-only hidden paper-derived tasks
replace Study A with execution-graded closed-loop tasks
run both in the current cycle
round8_decision_records.rationale: Execution grading removes judge dependence, but the reviewed environment requires one GPU and about 24 hours per task in isolated containers, which the declared local resource ceiling cannot supply; running both would break matched budgets and exhaust the episode ceiling.
round8_decision_records.decision: Keep the design-only Study A. Execution-graded closed-loop evaluation stays deferred as Study C, now with a secured hosted-GPU execution path; it remains blocked on pre-registration rather than on access.
round8_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Preserves an executable current-cycle causal path; risk is that design-quality endpoints may not predict execution outcomes.
round8_decision_records.falsifier: If a design-score advantage fails to appear in any execution-graded replication, the design endpoint loses construct validity and Study A conclusions narrow to planning artifacts only.

required_before_launch: committed pre-registration with objective, fixed command, input digests, est_CU, stop rule, checkpoint plan
answered Q-0005 for the first GPU unit
cost ledger row opened before launch

round8_decision_records.question: Should retrieval conditioning become a separate Study A factor?
alternatives: add a fifth complexity-routed condition
treat conditioning as an inside-C11 mechanism with a secondary endpoint
ignore conditioning entirely
round8_decision_records.rationale: Complexity-conditioned routing is a positive precedent, and it explains why an unconditioned retrieval arm can be null or harmful; but adding a fifth arm breaks the 2x2 identification and the declared episode ceiling, and the reviewed classifier is trained from the same strategies it selects among.
round8_decision_records.decision: Keep four conditions. Log per-episode retrieval decisions and score retrieval-decision quality as a preregistered secondary endpoint inside the retrieval-on conditions.
round8_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Explains heterogeneity in the retrieval main effect without new arms; risk is that the secondary endpoint is underpowered and only descriptive.
round8_decision_records.falsifier: If retrieval-decision quality does not separate productive from unproductive episodes, the conditioning explanation for H-B heterogeneity is rejected.

round8_decision_records.question: What must the evaluator add before the pilot runs?
alternatives: keep deterministic redlines plus blinded rubric only
add integrity probes and failure attribution
defer both to confirmation
round8_decision_records.rationale: Open-ended long-horizon grading is gameable through grading-script edits, data leakage, and hardcoded metrics, and self-generated critique is not independent support; separating ideation from implementation failure requires a controlled disclosure condition rather than post-hoc reading of transcripts.
round8_decision_records.decision: Add fail-closed integrity probes to the evaluator gate and add an ideation-versus-implementation attribution arm to the instrument pilot by disclosing the withheld target idea without resources on a fixed task subset.
round8_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Makes scores harder to game and localizes failures; risk is added pilot cost and a disclosure condition that leaks target information if the subset is later reused.
round8_decision_records.falsifier: If integrity probes never fire on deliberately corrupted fixtures, the gate is decorative and must be redesigned.

required_resources.repositories: source-paper repositories with execution-based grading scripts

round9_decision_records.question: How do we know the structured research state was actually used in condition C10/C11?
alternatives: assume delivery equals use
ask the agent to self-report use
instrument a manipulation probe on the delivered artifact
round9_decision_records.rationale: A comparable ablation of persistent external context reported a null and could only interpret it because a manipulation probe showed the artifact was consumed; without that probe a null confounds "state does not help" with "state was never read". Self-report is not independent.
round9_decision_records.decision: Add a manipulation probe: a unique unguessable token is embedded in the structured state and the scored artifact must reference the state field carrying it; episodes failing the probe are quarantined before scoring, not silently averaged.
round9_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Makes a null H-A interpretable; risk is that the probe itself cues the agent to reference state superficially, so the probe checks reference to a decision-relevant field rather than the token string.
round9_decision_records.falsifier: If probe-passing and probe-failing episodes show the same score distribution, the probe measures compliance rather than use and must be redesigned.

round9_decision_records.question: How should a null structured-state result be reported given the 192-episode ceiling?
alternatives: report the null as "no effect"
report the null as underpowered and uninformative
pre-register an equivalence margin and test it
round9_decision_records.rationale: Null-hypothesis tests cannot establish absence, published paired comparisons frequently fail a resolution target, and underpowered designs are the norm in this literature; declaring "no effect" without a margin would be unsupported and declaring nothing wastes the block.
round9_decision_records.decision: Pre-register an equivalence margin on the continuous design score and test it with TOST on a task-clustered bootstrap; report the resolution target alongside every pairwise contrast and mark any contrast that cannot meet it as unresolved rather than null.
round9_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Turns an expected null into a bounded claim; risk is that the chosen margin is too wide to be scientifically meaningful, so the margin is fixed before any score is seen and justified against the redline definition.
round9_decision_records.falsifier: If the pre-registered margin exceeds the smallest score difference that changes a redline classification, the margin is meaningless and must be tightened.

round9_decision_records.question: What must the condition-blind judge demonstrate before its scores are admitted?
alternatives: agreement with a human subset only
agreement plus severity and halo diagnostics
replace the judge with deterministic checks alone
round9_decision_records.rationale: Judges with equal human agreement can differ greatly in severity, repeated calls make a biased score stable rather than valid, single-call sub-scores share a halo, and outcome-only judging misses failures that are silent in the artifact; deterministic checks alone cannot score open-ended design quality.
round9_decision_records.decision: Admit judge scores only after a calibration run on a human-anchored subset reports agreement, severity relative to the human anchor, and halo across dimensions; score each dimension in a separate call; add a step-level review pass for silent failures; use replication for stability and the human anchor for validity.
round9_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Separates rater bias from treatment effect; risk is added scoring cost and a smaller human anchor than ideal.
round9_decision_records.falsifier: If severity drift between judge versions exceeds the pre-registered equivalence margin, judge scores are inadmissible for cross-version comparison.

round9_decision_records.question: Should the two-repeat allocation change?
alternatives: increase repeats per task
decrease repeats and add tasks
keep two repeats and decompose variance
round9_decision_records.rationale: Repeat allocation should follow measured variance shares rather than convention, but no local variance components exist yet, so any change now would be arbitrary; the pilot is the instrument that produces those shares.
round9_decision_records.decision: No change. Keep two repeats, and pre-register a crossed random-effects decomposition of episode variance into task, condition, repeat, and residual so the confirmatory allocation is chosen from measured intraclass shares.
round9_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Preserves the current ceiling while making the next allocation evidence-based; risk is that the pilot is too small to estimate components precisely, which is recorded as a known limit.
round9_decision_records.falsifier: If task variance dominates residual variance, adding repeats cannot buy resolution and the design must add tasks instead.

round10_decision_records.question: Does the manipulation probe measure use of the structured state, or only compliance?
alternatives: keep verbatim field-name echo in the deliverable
drop the probe
respecify as filled-field consumption plus a carry-through signal
round10_decision_records.rationale: In the executed pilot all 8 structured episodes filled the scaffold while 7 of 8 never echoed the field name, so the probe fired on episodes whose state was demonstrably consumed. That is the failure this decision record predicted in its own falsifier: the probe measured verbatim compliance, not use.
round10_decision_records.decision: Respecify the probe: consumption is evidenced by a filled required field in the state artifact; carry-through of that field value into the design is reported as a separate weak signal; verbatim echo is retained only as a diagnostic and never quarantines an episode.
round10_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: A null structured-state result stays interpretable without discarding valid episodes; risk is that a filled field is itself shallow compliance, which the carry-through ratio is meant to expose.
round10_decision_records.falsifier: If carry-through ratio is uncorrelated with any scored dimension across the confirmatory block, the respecified probe is also compliance-only and the structured-state factor cannot be verified.

evidence.observed: scaffold filled 8/8, verbatim echo 1/8, respecified consumption 5/8

round10_decision_records.question: The deterministic layer fired on no real artifact. Is it fit for the primary validity endpoint?
alternatives: keep fabrication redlines only and let the rubric judge carry discrimination
abandon the deterministic layer
add structural-completeness checks
round10_decision_records.rationale: Fabrication redlines fired on 0 of 16 executed artifacts while firing on every corrupted fixture, so they are correct but insensitive against competent output; leaving discrimination to an uncalibrated judge would concentrate the endpoint on the least independent layer.
round10_decision_records.decision: Add five deterministic structural-completeness checks covering ablation, uncertainty method, concrete named resources, a declared primary outcome, and a stopping rule or falsifier. They flag 13 of 16 pilot artifacts. Freeze them before confirmation.
round10_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Restores deterministic discrimination for the validity endpoint; the risk is severe and explicit: these checks were specified after observing pilot artifacts, so the pilot tasks become development data and the checks must be re-validated on unseen tasks.
round10_decision_records.falsifier: If the frozen checks flag every unseen confirmatory artifact or none of them, they carry no information and the validity endpoint must return to rubric scoring with an independent anchor.

round10_decision_records.question: Which model backend executes Study A episodes?
alternatives: the session provider
a hosted alternative provider
a self-hosted open-weights selector
a CPU compute instance
round10_decision_records.rationale: A live probe of four candidates returned: the session provider at HTTP 429 with its usage limit reached and a multi-day reset; one hosted provider timed out at 240 s; one router returned HTTP 402 for insufficient credits; two selectors answered correctly. Scaffold and orchestration studies both show effects are backbone-conditioned, so the backbone must be pinned and reported rather than treated as interchangeable.
round10_decision_records.decision: Pin the treatment backend to a single available selector for all conditions and reserve a different provider family for rubric judging, so judge and treatment do not share a blind spot. Record the probe outcome and the pin in the cost ledger.
round10_decision_records.expected_effect_and_risk: Removes provider variation from the contrast and keeps the judge family separate; the cost is that all Study A conclusions are conditioned on one backbone and cannot be generalized.
round10_decision_records.falsifier: If the pinned selector becomes unavailable mid-block, the block is invalidated rather than silently completed on a substitute.

probe.openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol: HTTP 429 usage limit reached, resets in about 4.8 days
